question: This is the as-found single-line diagram of a building's 480 V switchgear. Breakers 52-M2 and CB-03 both trip at the same moment. Nothing else changes: no other breaker opens or closes, normally-open (N.O.) breakers stay open, and Generator G1 keeps running. A load has power only if a path of closed breakers connects it to a running source. Which loads that were running before the event have no power afterwards? A load behind an open breaker was not running. Answer with the load tags (for example CH-2), in the order they appear on the drawing from left to right, separated by commas.
references: IEEE Std 141 (Red Book), secondary-selective / main-tie-main low-voltage switchgear single-line diagrams
IEEE Std 315 / ANSI Y32.2 graphic symbols and ANSI/IEEE C37.2 device numbers (52 = AC circuit breaker)
